description: This file defines a React functional component called PlayerBar, which provides a persistent playback control interface for a music application. It uses Material UI components and icons, and interacts with a PlayerContext for managing playback state.

methods.name: handlePlayPause
methods.description: Dispatches play or pause action based on current playing state.

methods.name: handleSkip
methods.description: Dispatches skip action in a given direction ('forward' or 'back').

methods.name: handleVolume
methods.description: Updates the volume state based on user interaction with the volume slider.
